name: screenplay
description: Turns any part of a web app (one feature, a whole module or a flow across modules) into polished films: promos, walkthroughs, trailers, teasers, release highlights, store previews and how-tos. It learns the app's branding from its code, maps the screens and traces them to the backend so a film never claims what the app cannot do, then rebuilds the screens from the code with demo data only, never running the app, and builds one Motion film per brand, checked against fixed film rules and improved from comments. Three skills: brand-profile learns the brand, app-map maps a feature, module or flow into a truth ledger, and app-film makes, checks and revises the films.
